text:
jordana: Quick thread on invoice CTA placement + spend breakdown microcopy. Want a short decision before next sprint.
kevin: Posted updated mock: https://www.figma.com/file/UPDATED_MOCK --- two variants:
  A) Primary invoice CTA up top in header when Org scope is selected, per-row export icon hidden
  B) Left rail scope chips (Org / Project) + per-row download icon visible for projects; header CTA remains but de-emphasized
pm_liu: FYI: Legal and finance using term 'Invoice' in contracts. We'd prefer CTA that reads 'Download invoice'.
anya: UX note: Users often miss left rail controls on narrow viewports. If we rely on left-rail chips we need to ensure they're visible on tablet (>=768px) or provide a fallback header control.
sam: Backend perf concern: per-row invoice link requires fetching invoice_metadata for each project. Could be a lot of calls for accounts with many projects.
a11y-bot: Accessibility check: the toggle must announce changes to assistive tech, and per-row icons must have accessible names like 'Download invoice for <project name>'. Avoid icon-only buttons without text alternatives.
jordana: Proposed compromise: Keep a single prominent header CTA for Org scope. When Project scope selected show inline icon on visible rows only (lazy-load metadata). Add a secondary 'Download all visible invoices' action in an overflow menu for bulk exports.
kevin: Updated mock includes small inline label 'CSV' below icon for clarity. Also adds hover tooltip.
pm_liu: Agree with 'Download invoice' CTA text. For bulk export, legal wants to check wording; will loop in finance.
anya: Keyboard flow: make sure left/right arrow moves between scope chips, Enter toggles. Also ensure focus ring visible for high-contrast themes.
sam: Est dev estimates: frontend 2.5d to add header CTA + lazy-load per-row, backend 1d to add batch invoice metadata endpoint.
jordana: Action items:
  - kevin: push updated figma with both responsive states
  - sam: draft backend endpoint ticket
  - anya: a11y acceptance criteria (chips, tooltips, icon labels)
  - pm_liu: confirm legal copy
  - jordana: mark ready-for-dev when figma + tickets linked
a11y-bot: a11y-bot: flagged missing aria-live region for confirmation toast when downloads complete.
jordana: Good catch, add toast copy: 'Invoice(s) downloaded' + screen reader confirmation. I'll update the spec.
